title: Pinned-profile sqlite3_release_memory no-op

scope.rationale: The pinned profile omits SQLITE_ENABLE_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT, making sqlite3_release_memory an unconditional result-zero no-op used both publicly and by allocator alarm handoff.
excluded_responsibilities: SQLITE_ENABLE_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT builds and page-cache release behavior
Allocator mutex release/reacquire around calls to this function

external_source_responsibilities: Pinned build-profile proof that SQLITE_ENABLE_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT is omitted
src/sqliteInt.h::macro::UNUSED_PARAMETER::line-1326 folds the unused argument without a runtime call
dependencies.caller_closure: All active core source calls are covered: sqlite3_soft_heap_limit64 after dropping mem0.mutex and sqlite3MallocAlarm between mutex leave/enter. Test-only test1.c and external public callers are outside the core source inventory.

callers: src/malloc.c::function::sqlite3_soft_heap_limit64::line-95 calls at line 117 after leaving mem0.mutex
src/core/memory.zig Manager.setSoftLimit and Manager.alarmWhileUnlocked preserve the two active source call sites
src/core/public_api.zig::function::sqlite3_release_memory exposes the public transport; arbitrary external callers are accepted
callees: The active #else branch invokes only src/sqliteInt.h::macro::UNUSED_PARAMETER::line-1326 and returns zero; it has no runtime callee
src/pcache1.c::function::sqlite3PcacheReleaseMemory::line-1236 is confined to the inactive SQLITE_ENABLE_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT branch
assertions_branches_cleanup: src/malloc.c::function::sqlite3_release_memory::behavior::return::line-31-column-3::ordinal-0 is the sole active control-flow block
The profile selects the #else branch because SQLITE_ENABLE_MEMORY_MANAGEMENT is absent from SQLITE_BUILD_PROFILE.json library_defines
No allocation, lock, callback, I/O, state mutation, error path, or cleanup occurs inside the selected body; caller-owned mutex handoff remains outside this unit
upstream_tests: upstream/sqlite/test/malloc5.test exercises release semantics only under the memorymanage capability and is skipped for the pinned profile
upstream/sqlite/test/ioerr.test memmanage-ioerr1 is likewise guarded by memorymanage and does not apply to this no-op profile
upstream/sqlite/src/test1.c sqlite3_release_memory Tcl transport supplies upstream test access but is excluded from the core source inventory
The project memory.zig soft-limit alarm test and infrastructure differential cover the selected zero-result and mutex-handoff observations

contracts.ownership: No allocation, release, or ownership transfer occurs.
contracts.state_and_results: The argument is unused and no global state changes.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No lock, callback, or I/O occurs inside this function.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Cannot fail; callers continue with unchanged memory state.

representation_differences: The internal Zig function and exported Zig C-ABI transport both route to the same no-op owner.

oracle.protocol: Pinned-profile C and Zig public/infrastructure probes call the function with representative and boundary signed values and compare zero results and unchanged memory statistics.

assurance.oom: No allocation; exact no-op remains valid under OOM.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O or internal lock. Allocator caller lock handoff is separately assigned.
assurance.malformed_input: All c_int values are ignored identically.

integration.native_call_path: src/core/public_api.zig exports sqlite3_release_memory and memory.Manager alarm handoff calls the same native owner.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No competing production C or Zig owner.

independent_review.notes: Independent review must confirm the selected profile predicate, public/internal routing, and no hidden state mutation.

known_blockers: Translation, current-tree trace receipts, final public API ownership, and subsystem assurance remain separate promotions.
